content.comment_body: Hello everyone. Hope you're having a good day. I have a [product_name] [version_no] and I want to connect it to my local network using a Wi-Fi dongle. I understand that connecting to the network requires setting the SSID and Wi-Fi password on the [product_name], but unfortunately, I don't know how to do this. Could anyone help me solve this problem?

There is no need to configure an SSID or Wi-Fi password on the [product_name] controller, as it only has a LAN port. You will need a Wi-Fi dongle or access point that has both LAN and Wi-Fi capabilities. The setup takes place directly between the dongle and your router. Do you have specific details about the network hardware you plan to use? Best regards, [user_name]
Understood, thank you. I have not tried it yet. Have you personally done this recently?

Yes, I have tried this in several ways. Depending on what is available and the quality required, you can choose different products for home or industrial use. For my home setup, I use a Fritz!Box router — the [product_name] connects to one of the LAN ports, and I’m able to communicate with it using my smartphone or notebook. At my company, I use a compact WLAN access point that looks similar to a plug-in power supply. With a notebook, I can connect to the access point directly. My experience connecting the [product_name] controller has only been for short durations to set up machines. I’m not sure which network devices are suitable for reliable, long-term connections. Sometimes the least expensive options may not be optimal. Best regards, [user_name]
I use a Wi-Fi repeater. Then, I connect the [product_name] to the repeater using the ethernet port. It’s important to ensure the Wi-Fi repeater has an ethernet port.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing how to connect a [product_name] [version_no] controller to a wireless network using external devices, as the controller itself only has a LAN port and lacks integrated Wi-Fi. The main challenge is determining the correct network hardware and setup process needed for wireless connectivity. Users are sharing their experiences with third-party products and setups, expressing concerns about compatibility and long-term reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking to wirelessly connect their [product_name] [version_no] controller to a Wi-Fi network by configuring network credentials directly on the device.
